claims.text: The FDA empagliflozin label lists alcohol abuse among precipitating conditions for ketoacidosis.
claims.quote: Precipitating conditions for diabetic ketoacidosis or other ketoacidosis include under-insulinization due to insulin dose reduction or missed insulin doses, acute febrile illness, reduced caloric intake, ketogenic diet, surgery, volume depletion, and alcohol abuse.

headline.text: The FDA empagliflozin label lists alcohol abuse as a precipitating condition for ketoacidosis.

reported.text: Alcohol abuse is included among the label's precipitating conditions for diabetic or other ketoacidosis.
